Name: [Project] Win-rate measures must divide by closed deals (open deals don't count)
Description: crm-pipeline: a win rate is won ÷ (won + lost). Any measure named '... Win Rate' must build on [Win Rate] or [Closed Deals], never on [Deals], which includes open deals and drags the rate down.
Expression: Name.EndsWith("Win Rate") and not (Expression.Contains("[Win Rate]") or Expression.Contains("[Closed Deals]"))
